label: 15-mil vapor barrier (keeps ground moisture out of the tatami)
2 in rigid foam under the whole slab + edges (R-10): heat goes up, not into the ground
Radiant heat: PEX loops about 9 in apart, fed by an air-to-water heat pump
4 in concrete slab = thermal battery (stores heat for cold desert nights)
Hard zones (kitchen, bath, entry): porcelain tile, same heat
1/4 in cork underlay (adds cushion, low R-value)
Soft top: floor-heating tatami (15-30 mm) or wool felt; keep everything above the heat at about R-1.4 or less
